issue.body: In the database documentation (https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/docs/database.md), I fail to understand where is the table actually created. When I try to reproduce the example (with `sqlite`), I get: `sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: notes`. I'm probably missing an obvious piece. Help would be greatly appreciated. Thanks.
issue.title: How is the table created in the database documentation example?
